sections.content_text: Section 210 - Provision for Retained Assets (1) Where the property retained under sub-section (7) of section 206 is money only, or in part of money and other part is property- (a) the Deputy Commissioner of Taxes shall first use the money to pay the unpaid amount of the person deemed to be liable taxpayer under this sub-section; and in such case the amount paid from the said person shall be exempted from liability; and (b) where, after the use of the money under clause (a), whatever portion of the said amount remains, unpaid the Deputy Commissioner of Taxes may, through the Tax Recovery Officer, recover the remaining unpaid amount by selling any such immovable property, for this purpose shall have all the powers of a tax collector under this Act. 2) Nothing of the provisions of sub-section (1) and sub-section (T) of section 206, shall prevent the recovery of dues from the taxpayer by any means under this Act. (3) After the payment of the liability mentioned in sub-section (T) of section 206, if any property or asset remains, shall immediately be handed over to the person from whom the custody of the property was taken.
